[SWS_TS_14175]
⌈
A TBR configured as Time Master shall start the trans-
mission of sync message only if the network is available (link is up) and in one of the
following conditions:
• a valid time is set or updated by the application or
• the backupTimeStamp is successfully restored from persistent memory
⌋
